result.description: A fictional rack-friendly network archive node built for cold-storage workflows in studio vaults, research labs, and small backup rooms. It combines a low-noise enclosure, dual 10GbE uplinks, and mirrored solid-state caching for fast ingest before data is committed to the 2TB archival pool. Intended for fixed installation rather than consumer desktop use.
result.title: Northstar Lattice Silo 2TB Network Archive Node
result.title_description: 2TB network archive node with dual 10GbE and mirrored cache
